title: Sage attack record
description: A attack record (AttackRecord). Generated by `sage schema` from the metadata table (issue #21).

$schema.description: The JSON Schema an editor checks this file with; the game ignores it.

id.description: The record's id: name (this file's namespace) or namespace:name. A second definition of an id is an error; change one with "patch".

base.description: Inherit every field from another attack record, resolved after patches; this record's own fields win.

patch.description: true: change a record defined earlier in load order, field by field, instead of defining one. Objects merge; lists replace unless written "field+" (add) or "field-" (remove).

abstract.description: true: a template, usable as a "base" and never built into a record itself.

disabled.description: true (in a patch): remove the record.

sound.description: What landing this attack sounds like, in place of its damage type's sound (a war hammer and a dagger both do physical damage); empty = the damage type's. Names a sound record. (RecordRef<SoundRecord>)

effects+.description: Adds to "effects": what a base or an earlier definition listed, then these.

effects-.description: Removes these from "effects" (as a base or an earlier definition listed it).

delivery.description: A registered hit delivery: sweep, ray or projectile; empty = sweep. (string, default "sweep")

range.description: How far a ray or a projectile reaches; a sweep uses reach. Unit: m. At least 0. (float, default 100)

pellets.description: Rays or projectiles per strike, each landing its own hit. At least 1. (int, default 1)

projectileSpeed.description: How fast a projectile delivery's carrier flies. Unit: m/s. At least 0. (float, default 60)

projectile.description: The prefab a projectile delivery's carrier looks like; empty = invisible. Names a prefab record. (RecordRef<PrefabRecord>)

projectileGravity.description: How fast a projectile delivery's carrier falls; 0 flies straight (9.81 is Earth) Unit: m/s². At least 0. (float, default 0)

projectilePierce.description: How many targets a projectile delivery's carrier passes through before one stops it. At least 0. (int, default 0)

ammo.description: The item this attack spends; empty = infinite ammunition. Names a item record. (RecordRef<ItemRecord>)

magazine.description: Rounds the magazine holds, filled from the inventory by Reload; 0 = no magazine, each shot is taken straight from the inventory. At least 0. (int, default 0)

ammoPerShot.description: Rounds one shot spends. At least 1. (int, default 1)

reloadTime.description: How long a reload takes when the animation has no mag_in event to say when the magazine goes in. Unit: s. At least 0. (float, default 2)

automatic.description: Fires every time the cooldown allows while the button is held, not once per press. (bool, default false)

rateOfFire.description: Shots a second (replaces cooldown when above 0) Unit: shots/s. At least 0. (float, default 0)

spread.description: How far a shot may stray from the aim; empty = it flies true. Names a spread record. (RecordRef<SpreadRecord>)

recoil.description: How a shot kicks the wielder's aim; empty = no kick. Names a recoil record. (RecordRef<RecoilRecord>)

block.description: How a fighter holding this guards (a block record); empty = it cannot block. Names a block record. (RecordRef<BlockRecord>)

cleave.description: How many bodies a sweep strikes, nearest first, within its reach and arc; 1 = the first it meets. At least 1. (int, default 1)

knockback.description: How hard a landed blow pushes a character along its direction, less what a block stopped. Unit: m/s. At least 0. (float, default 0)

knockbackLift.description: And how hard it pushes it up. Unit: m/s. At least 0. (float, default 0)

stagger.description: How long a blow that hurt staggers its victim: its swing is lost and it cannot swing or guard; 0 = no stagger. Unit: s. At least 0. (float, default 0)

reaction.description: The trigger a blow that hurt sets on its victim's animator (a flinch); empty = none. (string, default "")

friendlyFire.description: Who it may hurt, by faction: Default (a player anyone, others not their allies), Anyone, NotAllies, Hostile or Allies. (FactionFilter, default "Default")
